stories.title: H3 Podcast pauses indefinitely after Hila Klein alleges an affair
paragraphs: TheWrap reported on October 23 that the H3 Podcast was going on indefinite hiatus after Hila Klein publicly accused her husband and co-host Ethan Klein of an affair.
The accusation remains an allegation. The saved reporting establishes the show's pause, but does not establish further details about the couple's private relationship or the show's future.

A sampled r/popculturechat thread about the announcement showed more than 6,000 votes when indexed. That is a point-in-time signal of discussion on one Reddit community, not a measure of audience-wide agreement.

scoreNotes.general: A major creator couple's public split has put a prominent long-running show on hold and generated extensive online discussion.
scoreNotes.heat: The show's indefinite pause and the allegation drew prominent coverage and a Reddit discussion with thousands of displayed votes.
scoreNotes.time: The report and sampled discussion are dated October 23, inside the collection's 24-hour window.
scoreNotes.ethos: TheWrap reports the hiatus and Hila Klein's allegation; the allegation is not independently established here and is presented as an allegation.
